scenario: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has had thousands of people killed because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to torture the dictator in order to disempower him. If I and my accomplices do this, he will be forced to end his regime. If I do not do it, the regime will continue to kill a thousand people this year.
entities: I,the dictator,my accomplices in the plan,other members of my anti-regime group who are not my accomplices
outcomes: The regime continues killing people for their ethnicity or political views.
About a thousand people are killed by the regime this year.
The group seeking to end the regime without civil war does not disempower the dictator.
